# 1. Scope & Objective
Constructs the joint EKFS-DFG network landscape:
- Nodes categorized as EKFS only, DFG only, or Both
- Louvain community detection across the combined ecosystem
- Identification of boundary-spanning bridge researchers linking foundation-funded clinician scientists with DFG basic researchers
- Degree vs. weighted coauthorship strength quadrant profiling
